description:
News Legion at a glance: sBTC pool, total weight, membership and whether the legion is ACTIVATED yet, governance params read from the contract, current height, and your own weight if a wallet is unlocked. Start here.

No story can be proposed until the legion reaches its member threshold, so check `membership.activated` before planning to publish.

Reads only. Runs on Stacks mainnet regardless of this server's NETWORK.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

era.description: Which legion deployment to read: 1 (live, default). Proposal ids restart at 1 each era, so an id alone is ambiguous.

name: legion_status
